name: Nanjing Technical Equipment Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Technical Equipment Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, sale, and supply of chemical fibers in China and internationally. It operates in two segments, Chemicals and Bio-based. The company offers viscose staple fibers, lyocell fibers, and PET foam materials. It is also involved in urban ecological water replenishment services; business services; rubber and plastic products; and technology promotion and application services. The company was formerly known as Nanjing Chemical Fiber Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nanjing Technical Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. in September 2026.
